evidence.supports: Round (Flat) Mountain is an entry in Jackson County
The Forest Lookouts page names the Nantahala National Forest

notes_for_editor: Thin record. The only Forest Lookouts page for this site has three lines for North Carolina: the section label, the site name and the Nantahala National Forest. The agency fact comes from that last line alone. Two web searches, the Forest Lookouts index, firelookout.org's NC index (almost no text returned) and Wikipedia (no list page found) turned up no build, height, staffing or condition source. The record's other name 'Round Mountain' is the page title; the TN Landforms list keeps only 'Round (Flat) Mountain'. Story is much shorter than the usual minimum because the sources are; nothing was padded. Access unknown.
